newsitem.title: ITALY: Bank of Italy governor meets President Scalfaro.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Italy governor meets President Scalfaro.

text.p: Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio met President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro on Saturday at the Quirinale presidential palace, the news agency ANSA reported.
Financial markets are closely watching the Bank of Italy for any moves to lower its official interest rates.

Prime Minister Romano Prodi, in Denver for a Group of Seven summit, said on Friday that interest rates were "enormously high", especially given Italy's record low inflation rate which is in the 1.5 percent to 1.8 range.

But Fazio has said he is not sure inflation is beaten and has kept the official discount rate nailed at 6.75 percent since January, meaning real interest rates of five percent are much higher than in other European Union countries.
